zip.soma_rows_hash_encoding: Manifest order; for each cell: uint64le byte length + UTF-8 cell, then uint64le byte length + raw first SWC data line, including its line terminator when present.

laminar_classification.rule: Inside Isocortex: name contains 'layer', case-insensitively, or acronym equals parent acronym plus an accepted token. Read the token strictly as the suffix after the parent acronym; reject a laminar node with an unknown suffix.
laminar_classification.aggregate_tokens: 2/3 and 6 overlap finer tokens; no strict median-order test.

boundary_faces.pial: v2 reviewer correction: source token 1 and a neighbour that is background, Isocortex across the midline, or any other non-fibre structure except another region's layer-1 node: Dirichlet phi=0. v1 used only background neighbours, leaving the medial and orbital pial surfaces no-flux.
boundary_faces.white_matter: Source token 6b and neighbour descendant-or-self of 1009: Dirichlet phi=1.
boundary_faces.other: Omitted, including every off-grid face: no flux.
boundary_faces.ghost_discretization: Boundary value is at neighbour centre. Each Dirichlet face adds 1 to diagonal and its prescribed value to RHS.
boundary_faces.l6a_fibre_faces: Diagnostic only; never a Dirichlet boundary.

frozen_conventions.components: v2: six-connected components labelled separately on each side of the midline (no coupling across ML 5700 um). Solve each component only if it has both pial and white-matter faces. Other components retain NaN.

solver.success: CG info=0, finite solution/residual, final residual <= rtol.

gradient.arithmetic: Unrounded float64 solution; evaluated on demand at soma voxels.
gradient.eligible_neighbours: Finite, solved domain voxels only; no boundary ghosts.
gradient.missing: Any nonfinite component or norm < 1e-12 per um.

sampling.coordinate_parse: fractions.Fraction of each decimal coordinate token
sampling.voxel: floor(coordinate/25), independently on AP, DV, ML
sampling.invalid_sample: Depth and all frames missing if outside, unsolved or invalid gradient.
sampling.depth_squared: Derived downstream as CSV depth squared; preserves missingness.

frame.t1: Normalize e_AP-(e_AP dot r)*r; use projected e_ML if norm < 1e-6.
frame.hemisphere: Exact soma ML <5700: left; >5700: right; equality: ambiguous.
frame.right_canonical: M=diag(1,1,-1); r_c=M*r, t1_c=M*t1, t2_c=r_c cross t1_c.
frame.ambiguous_canonical: Retain valid depth/raw frame; canonical frame blank; missing_reason=ambiguous_hemisphere.

npz.flat_indices: uint32, ascending C-order flat indices of solved voxels
npz.phi: float32, corresponding values; unsolved/outside voxels omitted

outputs.quantiles: numpy.quantile, method='linear', over solved float64 values
outputs.creation: Exclusive creation; chmod 0444 after successful writes.

input_access.somata: All manifest roles permitted; no role affects the field.
input_access.swc: Skip initial blank/comment lines; parse only the first data row, requiring node=1, type=1, parent=-1. Never scan later data rows.
input_access.zip: Central-directory metadata and first soma rows only. No whole-ZIP hash or full-member CRC verification.

solver_settings.success: CG info=0, finite solution/residual, final residual <= rtol.

diagnostics.expected_laminar_pattern: Increasing depth from layer 1 toward layer 6b.

surface_pinning.bitmask_encoding: One uint8 per domain voxel in ascending flat-index order; bits 0..5 are AP-, AP+, DV-, DV+, ML-, ML+.

cortical_laplace_field.npz.float64_hash_encoding: Unrounded float64 little-endian values, in ascending solved flat-index order; raw element bytes without header.
